measure: edge length of the container divided by the edge length of the pieces
format: [x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz] per piece: a copy of the canonical piece solid (src/solids.json, 50-digit coordinates in src/solids_hp.json) rotated by the scalar-first quaternion q and centred at (x, y, z); container = s_full x canonical container solid, centred at the origin, canonical orientation
method: generalized soft-to-rigid homotopy (r-rounding of the solid hardened under inward pressure), basin hopping, then sequential-LP / SLSQP tightening with per-pair separating planes
title: 2 truncated icosidodecahedra in a truncated icosidodecahedron
credit: soft-to-rigid method by Yohei Nakajima (2026); generalization to Archimedean, Catalan, prism and antiprism solids, basin-hopping search and certification developed with Claude (Anthropic) under Alejandro Zarzuelo's direction
